verdict.rationale: Decagon's own product pages describe several in-product AI insight and suggestion features. Ask AI answers open-ended questions over customer conversations, Suggestions detects knowledge gaps and drafts content, Watchtower surfaces flagged interactions against natural-language criteria, and Duet generates AOPs from past interactions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing-level product page claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask open-ended questions like “Why are customers requesting refunds?” to instantly analyze customer conversations.
Ask AI powers deeper analysis through flexible, conversational queries.
It automatically detects knowledge gaps and generates content drafts based on how your best human agents resolved those same issues
Watchtower reviews every interaction against your custom criteria and surfaces what matters most.
Analyze past customer interactions to automatically generate Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) rooted in actual customer needs.
